title: Mall World Dreams?
content: I'll lucid dream on occasion, I've been doing so since I was a kid. I had nightmares and I wanted to control them. Anyway, it started with the endless walk. A path through the woods and endless stars in the sky, and people I've both met and haven't along the tree line. The next dream, I believe, was the bridge. I think they were zombies or something and we had to cross this huge stone bridge. Me and two others climbed down to the bridge support to cross that way. I woke up before we made it. Then there was this dock resting on the ocean and I had a submergible drone that dived under to search for something. There were cages, a bird in one of them. And the most recent one was me leaving a mall on an escalator and ending up in an empty airport terminal. I remember a big plane out the window and ambient music playing. It's been years, but occasionally I'll have other weird dreams like that. Ive never really written them down so I apologize if it's not the clearest description of each dream. But the one that stuck with me over the years was wandering an abandoned asylum, and there was an overgrown courtyard. Ive never had that dream since and I wasn't able to find any media where I got inspiration from it. Anyone else have dreams like this? Is this Mall World connected?
